complete.scope: Representation pilot only; no runtime, adaptivity, continuum accuracy or novelty claim

verification.scope: Recomputed saved 4x4 matrix metrics and hashes; field energy, local marking and vector-linearity metrics are checked for finite values and valid ranges, not recomputed from absent solution arrays.

aggregation: Median across three training seeds within each geometry, then median/quantiles across 16 geometries. Paired ratios are formed within geometry; classical rows are never replicated as seeds.

decision.scope: Prespecified representation hypothesis only; no significance, runtime, AMR, continuum certification or novelty claim.
decision.structure_check_scope: All symmetric raw rows, including every seed, signed mixture and per-combination linearity; no median hides a violation.
